groups.title: Start Any Multiball
groups.tooltip: GUIDE: Qualify any main multiball: Jam by shooting 6 ramps, Album by completing 3 target banks, or Tour by shooting 8 loops. When a multiball insert flashes, shoot the right ramp to start it.
groups.notes: Grouped duplicate placement. Replaces super-jackpot aftermath text with the actual multiball-start requirements.

groups.title: Start 2x Playfield
groups.tooltip: GUIDE: Hit the bell 3 times to start 2X playfield scoring for 20 seconds. Additional bell hits while 2X is active reset the timer.
groups.notes: Grouped duplicate placement. Keeps the guide instruction but trims it into a direct How to Achieve tooltip.

groups.title: Collect a Song Jackpot
groups.tooltip: GUIDE: The Song Jackpot is lit at game start; otherwise complete FIRE 3 times to relight it. Shoot the right ramp to load the Cannon, then fire at the center AC/DC target.
groups.notes: Grouped duplicate placement. Replaces song-selection context with the actual Song Jackpot collect path.

ids: ac dc|easy|2|spell f i r e once
ac dc|medium|4|spell f i r e once
groups.title: Spell F-I-R-E Once
groups.tooltip: GUIDE: Roll through the unlit FIRE inlane/outlane letters, using flipper lane-change to rotate the lit lanes if needed. One full FIRE completion satisfies this task and builds toward relighting Song Jackpot.
groups.notes: Grouped duplicate placement. This task only asks for one FIRE completion, not the full three completions needed for Song Jackpot.

groups.title: Start 3x Playfield
groups.tooltip: GUIDE: Hit the bell 3 times to start 2X, then hit the bell 3 more times before 2X expires to start 3X playfield for 20 seconds. Bell hits during 3X reset the timer.
groups.notes: Grouped duplicate placement. Current task is suitable; tooltip just needs concise achievement wording.

groups.title: Start a Multiball and Collect a Jackpot
groups.tooltip: GUIDE: Qualify and start any main multiball, then shoot any lit jackpot shot before the multiball ends. Jam, Album, or Tour Multiball all satisfy the start requirement.
groups.notes: Hard-only related task. Replaces the incorrect Song Jackpot tooltip with multiball jackpot guidance.

editTypes.full_rewrite: Use when the title or tooltip is real but the guide context needs to be rewritten into direct achievement instructions.
editTypes.task_impossible: Use when the objective is not suitable for a player task; provide a replacement task and replacement_reason.
